name: beautifulrepo
description: Audit repository onboarding and draft clearly unpublished, evidence-linked release notes using local checks.

interface.shortDescription: Audit a repository or draft notes from local Git history.
interface.longDescription: Audit README, links and onboarding with local read-only tools, or prepare an unpublished release-notes draft from a local Git commit inventory. The standalone checks and inventory make no network requests; the agent session may send repository context to its configured model provider. Neither workflow publishes changes or proves a release shipped.
